pages.text: China's factory for **Nuclear Missiles**: an octagonal hall under two pagoda roofs, a furnace annex with its striped chimney, a conveyor of crates and a missile yard with a gantry crane on rails. Load its parts (a Strategic Missile Body, two Liquid-fuel Stages, a Boosted Fission Core, a Strategic Warhead Casing and a GPS Guidance Unit) and give it power: it builds by itself, its crane laying the missile out on the cradles section by section, **60 seconds** at 480 FE a tick for each.

The War Factory: 9 wide and 13 long. At the back left, the hall: a 5 by 5 ring of Fieldstone Wall two high round a floor of Launch Pads. At the front left, the furnace annex: a 3 by 3 of Fieldstone Wall two high, its chimney (Fieldstone Wall) six high in the front left corner. Down the right, the missile's yard, three Launch Pads wide and eleven long, with a row of Crane Rail along its far side. Launch Pads everywhere else, the controller in the middle of the front row, an Energy Port and an Item Port in the back row. Keep the yard, the crane's way and the space over the hall clear.
